description: This file defines the Date class in PhpSpreadsheet library, providing methods for creating and manipulating date values within spreadsheet calculations, including handling of various input formats and adjustments for Excel date systems.

classes.name: Date
classes.description: Provides static methods for creating and manipulating dates within spreadsheet calculations, accommodating various input formats and Excel date conventions.

methods.name: fromYMD
methods.description: Constructs a date value from year, month, and day inputs, handling array inputs as well, and applying necessary adjustments based on Excel date system rules.

methods.name: getYear
methods.description: Converts the year input, in various formats, to an integer and validates its range.

methods.name: getMonth
methods.description: Converts the month input, possibly a string or number, to an integer month representation.

methods.name: getDay
methods.description: Converts the day input, possibly a string or number, to an integer day of the month.

methods.name: adjustYearMonth
methods.description: Adjusts the year and month values to ensure they are within valid ranges considering overflow and underflow, and validates the resultant date.
